text: Accepted at ScalaFIM eaca6c6 (Gale 441caa15e809622b606942461ebde326b96d2361). Independent base-R fixture agrees fold-by-fold for direction, training root, ridge, held-out root, mean, and correlation. Shared acceptance laws cover run/row/feature permutations, contrast scaling, nuisance-basis reparameterization, orthogonal feature rotations, response scaling, zero/perfect boundaries, deterministic null calibration, held-out signal recovery, and an 8192-row sufficient-statistics sentinel. Existing suites cover explicit dense-projector parity, repeated-root projectors, exact fold-scoped whitening, held-out-response leakage, ROI/searchlight traversal, and typed failures. Architecture scan finds spectral work only in Gale-backed multivar adapters; ordinary paired CCA remains Cca/PairedLatent. JVM/JS dependency matrix passed; compileAll and testAll passed.
